other_list:
D2. Missing h-H_X mixing term: the file keeps the H_X^2(H-dagger H) piece of the portal quartic but drops the v_Phi H_X(H-dagger H) cubic piece, so the two scalars never mix at tree level. Severity: substantive.
D3. Missing Z'-H vertex and Z-Z' mass mixing: MZp keeps the (1/4)x_H^2 v^2 piece from |D_mu H|^2 but no corresponding Z'-H coupling or Z-Z' mixing is written. Severity: substantive, small in size.
note: The review puts the factor-of-2 defect front and center as D1, corroborates it from three independent angles (the explicit 2 in LZpF, the unmultiplied MZp and LZpHX normalisation, and the stored width matching Eqs. 7-8 only without the 2), and tells the human to weigh it first, so it would send a physicist to the right place.
